title: Zenflow
description: Zenflow is a mixed reality relaxation system designed to reduce stress and improve sleep through guided breathing and gradual environmental transitions. Co-designed with mental health professionals, the system transforms the user’s physical space into a calming virtual environment.

publications.title: Zenflow: Investigating MR Transitions for Enhancing Sleep and Relaxation
publications.citation: Sasikumar, P., Sasikumar, P., Ramesh, S., Masuda, T., Qiao, H., and Nanayakkara, S. C., 2026. Zenflow: Investigating MR Transitions for Enhancing Sleep and Relaxation. In Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI 2026). Honorable Mention Award!
